Author: hiarc
Name: Ostinato
Description: Swaps the pressed action for the next step of your rotation, using per-job rules you can switch on and off.
TestingChangelog:
Test build for PR #21: M108–M113: composition tests, rules into Core, dead-code sweep, engine construction (cleanup S5–S6)

1. After reloading the plugin mid-combat while standing still, movement-only actions no longer flash up for the first half second.
2. A capture taken right after a reload now records the zone you're in.
3. Hostile labels are cleared when you change zone or log out, and the landed-action history is cleared when you change job or log in.
4. Status now shows dropped telemetry frames if the telemetry thread ever falls behind (normally 0).

Minor: the start-up probe lines are gone from the Dalamud log; a large internal cleanup of unused code with no behaviour change.
